threads.body: This bump also raises the YAML version selected by `scenarios/http/go` through its local `replace`, but that module still requires v3.0.5 and has no v3.0.6 checksums. The `Build Go` job runs `go vet ./...` in that module without relocking first, so it will fail on the stale module metadata. Run `otel-conformance-go relock` and commit the updated scenario `go.mod` and `go.sum` alongside this bump.
threads.hunk:
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@ module github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/tools/http/tes
 
 go 1.25.0
 
-require go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.5
+require go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.6
